scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Newsroom, Business blog and 2026 Marketing Playbook were checked on 17 October 2026. The playbook exposed a durable activation workflow: select for brand fit, explore credible unexpected cross-category connections, map audiences and objectives, use trend cues at different depths, align timing and make the result actionable or shoppable. One public Pinterest trend Pin was directly accessible and repeated familiar style labels; three other Pin or board pages returned HTTP 403 or no usable content, so no unsupported visual inference was made.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.22.0 with 718 commands was read before evaluation. /trend-to-brand covered visual-DNA translation but not the full Pinterest activation workflow, so it was expanded in place rather than duplicated. The release remains at 718 commands, 42 categories and 40 executable bundle mappings; all other commands, bundles, settings, personal creative intelligence and updater controls were preserved, and 18 regression checks passed.
trends: Pinterest recommends cross-functional trend activation spanning targeting, creative and product development
Brand-fit trend selection can be strengthened by credible unexpected cross-category connections
A trend can shape a full concept, story or visual system, or contribute only selected colors and imagery
Activation becomes operational when product world, audience, objective, palette, pattern, texture, timing and launch role are explicit
Trend-led creative should connect to an actionable or shoppable path rather than remain a mood board

Public Pinterest inspiration repeated AI-assisted workflow, retro futurism, chaos packaging, neo-minimalism, saturation revival, organic flow, interactivity and dual-aesthetic labels already covered by the catalogue
commands_updated: /trend-to-brand — expanded from visual-DNA translation into a brand-fit, cross-category activation system with audience and objective mapping, asset roles, seasonal timing, shoppable-path requirements, measurement hypothesis and safety constraints
skipped: No separate trend-activation or cross-category command because expanding /trend-to-brand avoids a duplicate entry and keeps the existing invocation compatible

No aliases were added for retro futurism, chaos packaging, neo-minimalism, saturation revival, organic flow or dual aesthetics because those are style labels already composable from existing visual, packaging, typography and layout controls
No command was derived from inaccessible Pinterest Pins or boards
No catalogue expansion was made from generic public-search snippets without a distinct reusable production workflow
